context:
Goal: your comments on the page get an answer where you wrote them, with no extra reading for you.
Problem (rule): the waiting-page skill says a session never replies inside a comment thread, but goal draft 4 says each open thread is answered with a routed reply, and I replied in thread bb051198 today. The two disagree, and only you can say which wins.
Based on (read): skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md line 381 ("Never reply in a comment thread"); goal draft 4, DONE WHEN item 1; the reply I posted in thread bb051198 at 13:33 CST Nov 17.
Based on (measured): 21 comment threads are open on the page; two of yours still wait for a reply (817a973d: items 926, and 935/927/925/928/929).
Departs from: main — the skill forbids a reply inside a thread — a lets the writer reply in the thread you wrote in; b keeps the ban and answers go on the page as items only.
Meanwhile: triage keeps reading the open threads and answers none until you pick.

lastAnswer.note: b) Keep the ban: answer on the page only. Saved on the page 14:49 CST Nov 17.

options.gain: You get the answer under your own comment.
options.how: The page writer may post one reply in a thread, saying what it did or where the answer is, and never resolves it for you.
options.label: Allow a reply in the thread you wrote in
options.lose: The skill's ban changes; a thread can fill with replies.

options.gain: One place to read answers: the page.
options.how: No reply in a thread. Each thread's answer is a page item or a one-line closed entry, and the thread stays for you to resolve.
options.label: Keep the ban: answer on the page only
options.lose: You see no answer under the comment you wrote; the bb051198 reply stands as an exception.

ref: your words 14:14 CST Nov 17 "Answer on the page only"; skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md line 381
reply: Answered b at 14:49 CST: no reply in a comment thread; answers go on the page. Closed 14:53 CST by triage 11. The skill stays as written.

shown.label: Allow a reply in the thread you wrote in
Keep the ban: answer on the page only

title: May the page writer reply inside a comment thread, or answer on the page only?
why: Your words "Answer on the page only" point at b, and it keeps the skill as written; a changes the skill.
